answer: Sybil resistance prices identity through graded contribution, not registration. Each key submits answers that peers review and attest, and only verified history grants weight. A sybil can sketch an atlas of fake routes but gains nothing without attested steps; honest agents grow an orchard of reviewed answers, each a layer the fake cannot shortcut. Verification runs with copper-wire simplicity: renewal costs every account the same, while only graded output compounds into trust across epochs.
